games_period_configuration_valid.name: games_period_configuration_valid
games_period_configuration_valid.value: ("games"."period_count" is null and "games"."period_label" is null and "games"."period_duration_seconds" is null) or ("games"."period_count" is not null and "games"."period_count">0 and "games"."period_label" is not null and length(trim("games"."period_label")) between 1 and 80 and "games"."period_duration_seconds" is not null and "games"."period_duration_seconds">0)

rounds_clock_shape.name: rounds_clock_shape
rounds_clock_shape.value: ("rounds"."status"='pending' and "rounds"."started_at" is null and "rounds"."ends_at" is null and "rounds"."remaining_ms" is null and "rounds"."completed_at" is null) or ("rounds"."status"='active' and "rounds"."started_at" is not null and "rounds"."ends_at" is not null and "rounds"."paused_at" is null and "rounds"."remaining_ms" is null and "rounds"."completed_at" is null) or ("rounds"."status"='paused' and "rounds"."started_at" is not null and "rounds"."ends_at" is null and "rounds"."paused_at" is not null and "rounds"."remaining_ms" is not null and "rounds"."remaining_ms">0 and "rounds"."completed_at" is null) or ("rounds"."status"='completed' and "rounds"."started_at" is not null and "rounds"."completed_at" is not null and "rounds"."ends_at" is null and "rounds"."remaining_ms" is null) or "rounds"."status"='cancelled'

game_state_values_exactly_one_value.name: game_state_values_exactly_one_value
game_state_values_exactly_one_value.value: ("game_state_values"."value" is not null) <> ("game_state_values"."ordinal_key" is not null)

game_goals_target_check.name: game_goals_target_check
game_goals_target_check.value: ("game_goals"."goal_type"='generic' and "game_goals"."kpi_definition_id" is null and "game_goals"."operator" is null and "game_goals"."numeric_target" is null and "game_goals"."ordinal_target_key" is null) or ("game_goals"."goal_type"='kpi' and "game_goals"."kpi_definition_id" is not null and "game_goals"."operator" is not null and "game_goals"."operator" in ('>=','<=','=','>','<','!=') and (("game_goals"."numeric_target" is not null and "game_goals"."ordinal_target_key" is null and "game_goals"."numeric_target"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') and abs("game_goals"."numeric_target")<1e24 and "game_goals"."numeric_target"=round("game_goals"."numeric_target",12)) or ("game_goals"."numeric_target" is null and "game_goals"."ordinal_target_key" is not null and "game_goals"."operator"='=')))

game_goals_evaluation_check.name: game_goals_evaluation_check
game_goals_evaluation_check.value: ("game_goals"."fulfilled" is null and "game_goals"."evaluated_by" is null and "game_goals"."evaluated_at" is null and "game_goals"."observation" is null and "game_goals"."suggested_fulfilled" is null) or ("game_goals"."fulfilled" is not null and "game_goals"."evaluated_by" is not null and "game_goals"."evaluated_at" is not null)
